Encode parameter tables on their own

Source: R/wire.R
encode_params.Rd

Encodes the parameter tables of a program() without the rest of it. The format has this message so that a program can be given new data without sending the whole program again; no function in this package sends it. Tables are written in a fixed order, so the same data always gives the same bytes.

Usage

encode_params(params)

Arguments

params

Parameter tables, as for program().

Value

A raw vector.

Examples

cost <- list(list(key = list(1L), value = 3), list(key = list(2L), value = 1.5))
encode_params(list(cost = cost))
#>  [1] 0a 28 0a 04 63 6f 73 74 12 0f 0a 04 0a 02 08 01 11 00 00 00 00 00 00 08 40
#> [26] 12 0f 0a 04 0a 02 08 02 11 00 00 00 00 00 00 f8 3f
